1-s3.condition: Lesson 31, упр. 1, с. 3. Прочитай и сравни предложения в Present Perfect и Past Simple.
steps: Present Perfect: результат к настоящему моменту, время не указано (already, just, yet, never, ever) — I have already read this book; I have just had breakfast; the boy hasn't drawn a picture of Moscow yet; Ann has never been to London.

Past Simple: действие в прошлом с указанием времени (last summer, an hour ago, yesterday, last year) — I read the book last summer; I had breakfast an hour ago; the boy didn't draw a picture yesterday; Ann wasn't in London last year.
1-s3.answer: Present Perfect — результат без указания времени; Past Simple — прошлое действие с указанием, когда оно произошло.

look-read-remember-s3.answer: begin/began/begun, choose/chose/chosen, draw/drew/drawn, drink/drank/drunk, eat/ate/eaten, have/had/had, spend/spent/spent, read/read/read, see/saw/seen, swim/swam/swum

steps: 2. I've had lunch. — When did you have lunch? — I had it an hour ago.

1-look-read-remember-s20.condition: Lesson 33, с. 20 (1). Прочитай и запомни формы неправильных глаголов.
steps: sing — sang — sung (петь); put (on) — put — put (класть, надевать); run — ran — run (бежать).

2-look-read-remember-s20.condition: Lesson 33, с. 20 (2). Прочитай и запомни формы неправильных глаголов.
steps: send — sent — sent (посылать); shine — shone — shone (сиять); shake — shook — shaken (трясти); forget — forgot — forgotten (забывать); buy — bought — bought (покупать).

10-s21.condition: Lesson 33, упр. 10, с. 21. Посмотри на картинки и скажи, что они сделали или не сделали.
steps: The boy has put on the gloves. The boy has run away from the dog. The children have sent the letter. The children have shaken the tree. The girl hasn't bought any bread.
10-s21.answer: has put on, has run away, have sent, have shaken, hasn't bought

11-s21.condition: Lesson 33, упр. 11, с. 21. Напиши правдивые ответы на вопросы.
steps: 1. Yes, I have. I made it yesterday. 2. Yes, I have. I ran fast at the PE lesson. 3. No, I haven't. 4. Yes, I have. I forgot my jacket at home when we were at the country house. 5. Yes, I have.
11-s21.answer: Yes, I have / No, I haven't + когда это было

12-s22.condition: Lesson 33, упр. 12, с. 22. Прочитай и сравни предложения с who и which.
steps: who — «который» о людях: People who read a lot know a lot. The boy who is standing at the blackboard is our best pupil. The girls who are coming into the room live in the village.

which — «который» о предметах и животных: The English book which I read yesterday was very interesting. The Vinegar Witch lived in a castle which was in the Wild Wood. Alice went on a trip which was very interesting.
12-s22.answer: who — о людях, which — о предметах и животных

13-s22.condition: Lesson 33, упр. 13, с. 22. Прослушай диалог «На железнодорожном вокзале», прочитай и выучи.
steps: — When is the train to Liverpool, please? — At 3:15, madam. — Which platform? — Platform four. — How much is the ticket? — Single or return? — Return, please. — Here you are. — Thank you.
13-s22.answer: Когда поезд до Ливерпуля? — В 3:15. — С какой платформы? — С четвёртой. — Сколько стоит билет? — В одну сторону или туда-обратно?

14-s22.condition: Lesson 33, упр. 14, с. 22. Составь свой диалог по таблице.
steps: A: When is the train to London, please? B: At 2:40, madam. A: Which platform? B: Platform eight. A: How much is the ticket? B: Single or return? A: Single, please. B: That will be twelve pounds. A: Here you are. B: Thank you, madam.
14-s22.answer: When is the train to …? — At … — Which platform? — Platform … — Single or return? — …

15-s23.condition: Lesson 33, упр. 15, с. 23. Прочитай и запомни пословицу, вспомни похожую русскую.
steps: So many countries, so many customs. — Сколько стран, столько обычаев. Русский аналог: «Что ни город, то норов», «Во всяком подворье своё поверье».
15-s23.answer: So many countries, so many customs — Что ни город, то норов.

16-s23.condition: Lesson 33, упр. 16, с. 23. Прочитай отрывок сказки и объясни, почему кота зовут Midnight.
steps: The cat's name is Midnight because it is black like the night.
16-s23.answer: Кота зовут Полночь, потому что он чёрный, как ночь.

17-s24.condition: Lesson 33, упр. 17, с. 24. Найди в тексте предложения к картинкам и прочитай.
steps: In a few minutes the magic plane was under a big old tree. Sarah was in the middle of the Wild Wood. Next to her there was an ugly old tree. It was difficult to walk because it was dark. By the time she saw the Witch's house it was already morning.
17-s24.answer: Предложения о самолёте под деревом, Диком лесе, уродливом дереве, тёмной дороге и доме ведьмы.

18-s24.condition: Lesson 33, упр. 18, с. 24. Прочитай предложения 1–5: TRUE, FALSE или DON'T KNOW.
steps: 1. Don't know. 2. False. 3. True. 4. False. 5. Don't know.
18-s24.answer: Don't know, False, True, False, Don't know

19-s25.condition: Lesson 33, упр. 19, с. 25. Перескажи сказку брату или сестре.
steps: The magic plane brought Sarah to the Wild Wood. She didn't know where to go. An ugly old tree spoke to her and told her that the Vinegar Witch had the magic mustard seeds. Sarah walked in the dark and in the morning came to the Witch's house, where she met the black cat Midnight.
19-s25.answer: Сара попадает в Дикий лес, говорящее дерево указывает дорогу, утром она приходит к дому ведьмы и встречает кота Полночь.

20-s25.condition: Lesson 33, упр. 20, с. 25. Скажи одноклассникам, нравится ли тебе Сара Свит и почему.
steps: I like Sarah Sweet because she is very brave and kind. She is ready to do everything for her friend.
20-s25.answer: I like Sarah Sweet because she is brave and kind.

21-s25.condition: Lesson 33, упр. 21, с. 25. Предположи, каким будет конец сказки.
steps: I think the Vinegar Witch will ask a high price for the magic mustard. Sarah will give her something very dear to her to save her friend. In the end Prince Pepper will get well.
21-s25.answer: The Witch will ask a high price, Sarah will pay it and the prince will get well.

22-s25.condition: Lesson 33, упр. 22, с. 25. Вставь подходящие предлоги в предложения 1–6.
steps: 1. by; 2. at, at; 3. in, over, over; 4. to; 5. for; 6. by, on.
22-s25.answer: by; at, at; in, over, over; to; for; by, on

23-s25.condition: Lesson 33, упр. 23, с. 25. Образуй наречия от прилагательных и составь предложения.
steps: sad — sadly: The boy is talking sadly. sweet — sweetly: The dog is sleeping sweetly. kind — kindly: Julia smiled at him kindly. quiet — quietly: The kids are playing quietly. beautiful — beautifully: He played beautifully. easy — easily: He can run the distance easily.
23-s25.answer: sadly, sweetly, kindly, quietly, beautifully, easily

24-s25.condition: Lesson 33, упр. 24, с. 25. Составь вопросы к тексту сказки.
steps: Where was Sarah? What did she hear? Who had the magic mustard seeds? Where does the Vinegar Witch live? Why was it difficult for Sarah to walk? Who was in the room? What is the cat's name?
24-s25.answer: Where was Sarah? What did she hear? Who had the seeds? Where does the Witch live? Why was it difficult to walk? Who was in the room? What is the cat's name?
